mapper.sql: SELECT m.message_id, m.order_id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.create_time, su.username AS sender_name FROM t_message m LEFT JOIN t_user su ON m.sender_id = su.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE m.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY m.create_time ASC, m.message_id ASC
WHERE m.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY m.create_time ASC, m.message_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, CASE WHEN o.publisher_id = #{userId} THEN tak.username ELSE pub.username END AS otherName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_message m WHERE m.order_id = o.order_id AND m.receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.is_read = 0) AS unreadCount, lm.content AS lastContent, su.username AS lastSenderName, lm.create_time AS lastTime FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user pub ON o.publisher_id = pub.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user tak ON o.taker_id = tak.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m1.order_id, m1.content, m1.create_time, m1.sender_id FROM t_message m1 JOIN (SELECT order_id, MAX(message_id) AS max_id FROM t_message GROUP BY order_id) mx ON m1.message_id = mx.max_id ) lm ON lm.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN t_user su ON lm.sender_id = su.user_id WHERE (o.publisher_id = #{userId} OR o.taker_id = #{userId}) AND o.status != '待接单' AND lm.order_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lm.create_time DESC, o.order_id DESC
